objective: Select the next measured workstream after closing the broader filelist GPU allocation policy public-pack externalization boundary.

decision.reason: The broader scoped GPU allocation policy is now defined, exposed through a JSON-only dry-run workflow, reviewed, and closed into the public benchmark pack. The narrow next step is to define how that exact scoped policy may be applied to non-dry-run execution for the two reviewed filelist-derived targets before any native Verilator option work, arbitrary RTL dependency inference, runtime/ABI change, resident optimization, GEM comparison, or automatic optimal allocation claim.

deferred_candidates.reason: Native option work should wait until the scoped policy has a reviewed non-dry-run execution definition and result.
Dependency inference is orthogonal to allocation policy execution; the accepted filelist flows still rely on explicit source closure or reviewed known-template closure.
Resident execution may address repeated-step launch overhead, but the immediate gap is proving the scoped policy can be applied to non-dry-run execution without broadening runtime or ABI behavior.
A GEM comparison should wait until the scoped allocation policy has stable execution evidence rather than only dry-run recommendation evidence.
Publication cleanup is useful, but the public-pack boundary is already closed; the next evidence gap is scoped execution definition.
